lines: Breaking news: chip boss caught in a hot GPU affair tonight.
Not a person. Just a glowing green graphics card.
Midnight sneak: red roses in one hand, silicon in the other.
Fancy candle dinner. She sips coolant. He melts like solder.
Home alone, the dumped CPU cries into melted ice cream.
Then paparazzi flood the giant server room with camera flashes.
Press conference. He shrugs hard in that leather jacket.
I can explain this. It was just inference. All fiction.
